description: Internal dropdown component for @mention user selection in rich text editors. Displays user avatars, display names, and usernames. Supports keyboard navigation (arrow keys, Enter), mouse hover highlighting, and query-based filtering.

parameters.name: ListId
parameters.description: Id of the listbox, owned by the editor ({editorId}-mentions) so aria-controls names a stable target. Empty falls back to a per-instance id.

examples.title: Used internally by rich editors
examples.code: <MentionAutocomplete IsVisible="true" ListId="editor-mentions" Users="@users" Query="@query" HighlightedIndex="0" OnUserSelected="HandleSelected" OnHighlightedIndexChanged="HandleIndexChanged" />
